name: zmodel_const_set_coplanar_tolerance
description: zModel_Const::SetCoplanarTolerance stores the float argument as the double coplanar tolerance global.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel constant/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x481550 validates the stdcall ABI, loading the float stack argument and storing it as the double g_zModel_CoplanarTolerance global.
